summary: The one-thread-per-row kernel checks row<dim, sums the complete row delimiter interval and stores output. Main computes its launch grid, records start, launches once per requested iteration, records/synchronizes end and copies the result. The compiled main and called stub through cudaLaunchKernel were inspected. CMake targets sm_70 and the SASS dump contains the sm_70 kernel through its CSR loop/store/exit. An untimed synchronized warmup precedes the event interval. Embedded sm70 PTX also retains the complete row/nonzero work; runtime-JIT machine code was not inspected.
